fusions.name: Shrieking Whirl
fusions.desc: Whirls the axe with a shriek, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles. Each has a 30% chance to be confused for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinpoint Echo
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet at an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 20 resonating damage. The blow then echoes to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Flit to the Rafters
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Vampire's Notch
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
